src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: User summary
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: A user as shown in the user list, including when they were disabled, if they were.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Assign and unassign flocks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Limits a worker to particular flocks, or removes one, after checking the extra confirmation, and records it in the activity log.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change own password
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Changes the signed-in person's password once they have given the current one.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change own password checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a password change with a missing current password or a new one that breaks the length rules.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change sign-in email
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Changes a user's sign-in email once the extra confirmation passes.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change sign-in email checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a blank or badly formed email address.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change role
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Changes a user's role after the extra confirmation passes, and records it in the activity log.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Change role checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a role change that names no valid role.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Create user
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Adds a new user with any allowed role, or as a plain worker, after the extra confirmation passes.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Create user checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a new user with a bad email, name, password or role.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Disable user
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Switches a user's account off after the extra confirmation, recording an optional reason.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Disable user checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a disable request with an invalid reason.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Enable user
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Switches a disabled user back on, restoring the account as it was.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Sign-in system outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes everything the app needs from its sign-in system: passwords, users, roles, tokens and two-step verification.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Extra confirmation outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes the recent-confirmation proof needed for sensitive actions such as creating users, password resets, role changes and disabling accounts.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Role assignment storage outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Describes how each user's role assignments are stored and looked up.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Reset two-step verification
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Lets an owner reset another user's two-step verification, as its own action needing extra confirmation.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set own language
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Saves the signed-in person's own language choice; it can never set another person's.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set language checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a language choice that is not valid.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set own egg counting unit
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Saves the signed-in person's own choice of egg counting unit.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Set egg counting unit checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses an egg unit that does not exist.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Reset user password
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Lets an owner set a new password for another user after extra confirmation, which also ends their old sign-ins.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Reset user password checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a new password that breaks the length rules.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Edit user name
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Changes a user's display name, only within the same farm.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.name: Edit user name checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Access.description: Refuses a display name that is too long.
